the role of delivery and product experience in reliability
sections.description: The speaker situates the Lands' End origin in a rural setting, ties a bold shipping guarantee to customer experience, and frames reliability as a core metric of business success derived from imagining and measuring how customers live and experience the product.
sections.title: Land's End origin and the start of a customer-focused philosophy

summary: Jeanne Bliss recounts an origin moment from her early career at Lands' End, describing starting work in 1983 in a rural setting near Dodgeville, Wisconsin. She highlights a catalog-driven retail era that relied on a strong guarantee: 98.6% of orders shipped within 24 hours. The talk emphasizes imagining customers’ lives and treating the delivery experience—how the UPS driver interacts and how it feels to try on a product—as essential signals of reliability and customer satisfaction, framing customer experience as the ultimate measure of brand success.
title: Do You Start with the Product or Your Customer? — Jeanne Bliss
